term: Congenital neuromuscular disorder with dysmorphic facies
definition: An ultra-rare autosomal recessive condition (OMIM #620775) caused by bi-allelic variants in the FILIP1 gene, characterized by early-onset muscle weakness with core-like myofibrillar disintegration and myopathology, variable neurological manifestations including neurodevelopmental delay and brain malformations, and syndromic dysmorphic features.

source.title: Bi-allelic variants of FILIP1 cause congenital myopathy, dysmorphism and neurological defects
source.quote: The combined findings of this study show that the loss of functional FILIP1 leads to a recessive disorder characterized by neurological and muscular manifestations as well as dysmorphic features accompanied by perturbed proteostasis and myopathology.
